messages:
ops-alerts: :rotating_light: Incident detected — intermittent 502s from Private control plane (eu-west-1) reported at 09:12 UTC. Affected: several private deployments (customer-facing APIs). Hosted and Dedicated unaffected. Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2135012345

sam: looking. I see a surge of upstream timeouts to the private-agent pods after a KMS key rotation event at ~09:10 UTC.

nina: confirming — auth handshake failures between private-agent and kms-proxy, then nginx upstreams start returning 502. Likely transient auth errors during rotation.

lee: CS alert sent to impacted customers (Acorn Health, Lumina Finance, BrightMed). Short note with ETA and mitigation steps.

devops-bot: manual scale triggered on private-agent-pool-3 -> replicas 8 -> 12 due to pod restart storm. Observing CPU spike on pool-3 nodes.

sam: mitigation plan: 1) pause/rollback KMS rotation for impacted VPCs 2) restart private-agent pods with delay 3) enable temporary retry/backoff on kms-proxy. Doing step 1 now.

security: tagging for post-rotation review. Please capture KMS logs and rotation context: command to fetch logs ->
```
kubectl -n infra logs deploy/kms-proxy --since=30m | grep rotation
```

amanda: noted. I'll coordinate customer comms and schedule a postmortem. Postmortem meeting proposed 15:00 UTC today.

cs-rep: customers acknowledged the update; one asked for a timeline, offered to provide rollback confirmation once done.

nina: rollback applied to Acorn Health VPC — observed auth handshakes start succeeding again, upstream 502 count decreasing. Continuing observation.

sam: rolling a hotfix to kms-proxy to add 5s retry + jitter for rotation path. Will push canary to eu-west-1 after CI passes.

devops-bot: canary deploy started: deployment/kms-proxy-canary in eu-west-1. Watch link: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/4521

ops-alerts: Update: impact reduced to degraded for 2 customers, others recovering. No hosted/Dedicated impact. Next updates in 30m or on status change.

security: reminder — collect rotation audit entries and share with SRE before postmortem.

amanda: thanks team. After-action items: (1) add retries and circuit-breaker to rotation flow, (2) add more granular alerting on KMS auth errors, (3) update runbook with rollback steps. I'll create the ticket and link in this thread.

ops-alerts: RESOLVED at 10:07 UTC — root cause: transient auth handshake failures during KMS rotation combined with aggressive upstream timeout settings. Resolution: rolled back rotation for impacted VPCs, applied retry patch to kms-proxy, scaled private-agent pool while patch propagated. Customers notified. Postmortem: https://redwood.ai/pm/INC-2135012345-postmortem

sam: closing monitoring window; call if any regressions. :white_check_mark:
